reconciliation.baseRevision: a79892f (branch dev) plus uncommitted working-tree changes
reconciliation.method: Each clause was read against the code, schema, tests, CI workflow and operations documents. Cited lines are static references.

statusDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED: Code path exists and a CI-run test exercises it. implementation and tests are cited.
statusDefinitions.PARTIAL: Some of the clause exists. gap states exactly what is missing.
statusDefinitions.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: No code for the clause. gap states what is absent.
statusDefinitions.OWNER_EVIDENCE: Needs owner, counsel or host evidence. ownerEvidenceNeeded states what.
statusDefinitions.OUT_OF_SCOPE_POST_LAUNCH: The source itself defers the clause after launch. sourceQuote is verbatim from the source.

verificationValues.UNIT_TESTS_PASSED: Every cited test file is in test:unit or test:domain, which passed on 2026-10-31 (245 node tests, 843 vitest tests).
verificationValues.STATIC_REVIEW_TESTS_NOT_RERUN: Code and CI-run tests were read. Tests need PostgreSQL, Redis or a browser and were not run in this reconciliation.
verificationValues.NOT_APPLICABLE: Nothing to verify: no code, or a deferred clause.

reconciliation.launchBlockingRule: launchBlocking is true when the clause is in launch-core scope (sections 1, 2 Required rows and 4 unless the module is optional, conditional, off or post-launch) or is named in the section 7 acceptance tests, section 13 gates or a Critical or High row of section 15, unless section 14 or 11 excludes it. It is a reading of the source, not an owner waiver.
